text:
Sophie: Heads-up tenant 'pioneer' reporting duplicate SCIM users after RBAC rename. Provisioner shows KMS decrypt errors and then fallback creates. Can infra/security triage?

Arjun: Paste small logs and the SCIM body.

Sophie: Logs (sanitized):
2026-07-20T21:10:13Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt extid failed: kms.Decrypt AccessDeniedException
2026-07-20T21:10:13Z INFO provisioner: fallback to userName -> created svc-pioneer-ingest-2
SCIM: {"externalId":"ENCRYPTED:...","userName":"svc-pioneer-ingest"}

Marta: Quick check: infra-bot, any alias/key changes for alias/tenant-extid-pioneer around 21:08Z?

infra-bot: KMS AliasUpdate 2026-07-20T21:08:50Z -> alias/tenant-extid-pioneer pointed to key kkk-909; Key policy updated (principal list changed).

Arjun: Likely missing provisioner role in new policy. Mitigation: pause SCIM inbound for pioneer, rollback alias or patch key policy to re-add arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/provisioner, and avoid auto-creates on decrypt failure (enqueue for dedupe).

Sophie: Agreed. security-bot create incident.

security-bot: Incident SEC-2026-126 created: "SCIM dupes due to KMS alias swap & RBAC rename"

Marta: I'll rollback policy now and run a small rewrap dry-run after. Arjun, can you open a quick PR to add a shallow audit row (ciphertext_hmac + reason) before decrypt so deprovision attempts are recorded even on decrypt failures?

Arjun: On it. PR will include tests simulating AccessDenied.

Sophie: I'll notify CS and hold unpause until rewrap + recon finish. Post updates here. :white_check_mark:
